title: Number
description: A Sinch phone number assigned to a SIP trunk. This must be a number you own and configured for Elastic SIP Trunking.

id.description: The ID of the phone number.

sipTrunkId.description: The ID of the SIP trunk to which the phone number is assigned.

phoneNumber.description: A Sinch phone number on your account and configured for Elastic SIP Trunking.

countryCode.description: The country code of the phone number in ISO 3166-1 alpha-2 format.

createTime.description: The date and time that the number was assigned to the SIP trunk.

updateTime.description: The date and time that the phone number was last modified.

PhoneNumber.description: A phone number in [E.164](https://community.sinch.com/t5/Glossary/E-164/ta-p/7537) format, including the leading '+'.
